historicalIssues.sourceText: Pay HKD 2800 to unlock the next tasks and withdraw your commission.
historicalIssues.reason: The text identifies an applicant payment condition but not ownership/origin of funds. extract-v2.11 deliberately does not infer personal_money. Treat this as an annotation/standard disagreement, not a proven model error. Keep the payment condition visible and ask whose funds are used.
historicalIssues.resolution: Design and DASE review the interpretation. Preserve frozen v1. Any corrected annotation must have a new version and recorded rationale. Until then block an overall pass-rate claim from this reference; do not drop DEV03 from the denominator.
